verdict.rationale: Shopify serves its agentic-commerce docs as raw markdown that an agent can ingest directly (shopify.dev/docs/agents.md returns HTTP 200 with frontmatter), and the open UCP spec publishes an llms.txt index at ucp.dev. However, Shopify's own developer docs have no llms.txt (shopify.dev/llms.txt returns 404), so the agent-readable entry point comes from the protocol site rather than the product's docs. missing for 10: a first-party llms.txt index on shopify.dev, an agent-oriented docs index or sitemap for the Shopify agent docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: https://ucp.dev/llms.txt serves the versioned specification index
